NYC Health + Hospitals consists of buildings and infrastructure of various ages and conditions across its many campuses. As the patient base has increased and the methods of delivering care has changed, the buildings, many of which are decades old, have to be constantly upgraded or replaced. This growth has driven the growth of the total square feet of the system to be maintained to over 20,000,000 sq. ft. The Office of Facilities Development (OFD) is responsible for maintenance and operations of all campuses and buildings to ensure the clinicians have the facilities needed to deliver care.
